Lifecycle and cleanup

Handle enablement, disablement and cooperative background shutdown.

Lifecycle callbacks

The native class has on_load, on_enable, on_disable and on_unload. Compatibility plugins implement on_plugin_load and on_plugin_unload and can receive app events through on_app_event.

Cleanup and stop signal

register_cleanup(callback) runs registered zero-argument callbacks in reverse order on unload, including when on_plugin_unload throws. stop_event.is_set() and stop_event.wait(timeout) let workers observe generation invalidation. Use finite waits and keep cleanup short.
